normalize_json_data: normalize semi-structured JSON data into a flat Polars DataFrame with nested keys separated by dots
normalize_json_with_max_level: normalize nested JSON data to a specific depth using max_level to control recursion depth
normalize_json_with_custom_separator: normalize JSON data using a custom separator string instead of the default dot separator
normalize_json_with_custom_encoder: normalize JSON data using a custom JSON encoder like orjson for binary encoding of nested dicts
normalize_empty_json_data: normalize an empty JSON sequence and return an empty Polars DataFrame with an optional schema
